name: Negroni
description: 尼格罗尼，一杯以金酒为主角的经典调酒。准备好材料，跟随步骤调出苦甜浓郁的风味。
steps: 在酒杯中放入冰块，倒入所列材料。
轻轻搅拌混合。
以半片橙子装饰。

english.description: Negroni: a bold & bittersweet classic featuring gin. Gather the ingredients and follow the steps to mix your own.
steps: Fill the serving glass with ice and add the listed ingredients.
Stir gently to combine.
Garnish with half an orange slice.

name: Margarita
description: 玛格丽特，一杯以龙舌兰为主角的经典调酒。准备好材料，跟随步骤调出清新酸甜的风味。
steps: 用盐装饰鸡尾酒杯杯沿。
将所列液体材料倒入摇酒壶，加入冰块。
充分摇匀后，滤入预先冰镇的鸡尾酒杯。
tool: 玛格丽特杯 · 摇酒壶

english.description: Margarita: a bright & citrusy classic featuring tequila. Gather the ingredients and follow the steps to mix your own.
steps: Prepare a salt rim on a cocktail glass.
Add the listed liquid ingredients to a cocktail shaker with ice.
Shake to mix and chill, then strain into a chilled cocktail glass.

name: Mojito
description: 莫吉托，一杯以朗姆酒为主角的经典调酒。准备好材料，跟随步骤调出清爽气泡的风味。
steps: 将薄荷、白砂糖和青柠汁放入高球杯中轻压。
加入少量苏打水及碎冰，倒入白朗姆酒。
用苏打水补满。
以薄荷叶和柠檬片装饰。
tool: 高球杯 · 捣棒 · 吧匙

english.description: Mojito: a fresh & fizzy classic featuring rum. Gather the ingredients and follow the steps to mix your own.
steps: Gently muddle mint, sugar and lime juice in a highball glass.
Add a little soda water and cracked ice, then pour in the white rum.
Top up with soda water.
Garnish with mint leaves and a lemon slice.

name: Whiskey Sour
description: 威士忌酸，一杯以威士忌为主角的经典调酒。准备好材料，跟随步骤调出清新酸甜的风味。
steps: 将威士忌、柠檬汁和糖浆倒入摇酒壶，加冰摇匀；蛋清可选。
滤入冰镇的鸡尾酒杯，或滤入装有新冰块的古典杯。
以半片橙子和樱桃装饰。

english.description: Whiskey Sour: a bright & citrusy classic featuring whiskey. Gather the ingredients and follow the steps to mix your own.
steps: Shake whiskey, lemon juice and syrup with ice. Egg white is optional.
Strain into a chilled cocktail glass, or into a rocks glass over fresh ice.
Garnish with half an orange slice and a cherry.

name: Espresso Martini
description: 浓缩咖啡马天尼，一杯以伏特加为主角的经典调酒。准备好材料，跟随步骤调出咖啡醇香的风味。
steps: 将伏特加、咖啡利口酒和一小杯浓缩咖啡倒入摇酒壶，按口味添加糖浆。
加冰摇匀，滤入冰镇的鸡尾酒杯。

english.description: Espresso Martini: a rich & coffee-forward classic featuring vodka. Gather the ingredients and follow the steps to mix your own.
steps: Add vodka, coffee liqueur and one short espresso to a shaker. Sweeten with syrup to taste.
Shake with ice and strain into a chilled cocktail glass.

name: Dry Martini
description: 干马天尼，一杯以金酒为主角的经典调酒。准备好材料，跟随步骤调出草本清冽的风味。
steps: 将所列材料与冰块放入搅拌杯。
轻轻搅拌至冰镇，滤入预先冰镇的鸡尾酒杯。
挤入柠檬皮精油，或用橄榄装饰。

english.description: Dry Martini: a herbal & crisp classic featuring gin. Gather the ingredients and follow the steps to mix your own.
steps: Add the listed ingredients and ice to a mixing glass.
Stir until chilled, then strain into a chilled cocktail glass.
Express lemon-peel oils over the drink, or garnish with an olive.

name: Old Fashioned
description: 古典鸡尾酒，一杯以威士忌为主角的经典调酒。准备好材料，跟随步骤调出苦甜浓郁的风味。
steps: 在古典杯中放入方糖，用苦精和少许水浸润后捣至溶解。
加满冰块，倒入威士忌。
以橙片和樱桃装饰。
tool: 古典杯 · 捣棒 · 吧匙

english.description: Old Fashioned: a bold & bittersweet classic featuring whiskey. Gather the ingredients and follow the steps to mix your own.
steps: Moisten the sugar cube with bitters and a little water in a rocks glass. Muddle until dissolved.
Fill the glass with ice and add the whiskey.
Garnish with an orange slice and a cherry.

steps: 将半个青柠切成四瓣，与糖一同放入古典杯中捣压。
加满冰块，倒入卡莎萨。
tool: 古典杯 · 捣棒 · 吧匙

english.description: Caipirinha: a bright & citrusy classic featuring cachaça. Gather the ingredients and follow the steps to mix your own.
steps: Cut half a lime into four wedges and muddle with the sugar in a rocks glass.
Fill with ice and add the cachaça.

name: Sazerac
description: 萨泽拉克，一杯以白兰地为主角的经典调酒。准备好材料，跟随步骤调出草本清冽的风味。
steps: 用苦艾酒润洗冰镇的古典杯，放入碎冰，暂置一旁。
将干邑、方糖和佩肖苦精与冰块搅拌混合。
倒掉酒杯中的冰和多余苦艾酒，滤入酒液。
以柠檬皮装饰。

english.description: Sazerac: a herbal & crisp classic featuring brandy. Gather the ingredients and follow the steps to mix your own.
steps: Rinse a chilled rocks glass with absinthe and add crushed ice. Set aside.
Stir cognac, the sugar cube and Peychaud’s bitters with ice.
Discard the ice and excess absinthe from the glass, then strain in the mixture.
Garnish with a lemon twist.

steps: 将所有液体材料倒入加冰的摇酒壶。
摇匀后，滤入高球杯。

english.description: Singapore Sling: a fruity & mellow classic featuring gin. Gather the ingredients and follow the steps to mix your own.

搅打均匀，倒入大酒杯或飓风杯。

english.description: Pina Colada: a creamy & smooth classic featuring rum. Gather the ingredients and follow the steps to mix your own.
steps: Add rum, pineapple juice, coconut milk and ice to a blender.
Blend until combined and pour into a large goblet or hurricane glass.
Garnish with a pineapple slice and a cherry.
